  2. Inventariseer het risico rond jullie (poorten, accounts, plugins, logs).
  3. Pas de beveiligingsmaatregel toe (patch, 2FA, firewall, WAF, secret rotatie) voor servers.
  4. Verwijder of disable wat niet nodig is.
  5. Test legitieme toegang én dat het misbruikpad geblokkeerd is.
  6. Roteer credentials die bij jullie, servers, voorkomen horen als er misbruik mogelijk was.
  7. Zet monitoring of een herhaalcheck in de agenda.

  • Geen regressie op een kritieke flow naast jullie servers voorkomen dat

Let op: Wijzig niet blind productie zonder backup als jullie, servers, voorkomen login, DNS, mail of betalingen raakt.

For Your servers prevent my site from being hacked follow a targeted checklist in security settings (panel, firewall or CMS). Core themes: servers, prevent, site.

Preparation

  • Access to security settings (panel, firewall or CMS)
  • Focus of this article: servers, prevent, site
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Sign in to security settings (panel, firewall or CMS). Filter or search for parts that belong to servers, prevent, site.
  2. Map the risk around servers (ports, accounts, plugins, logs).
  3. Apply the security control (patch, 2FA, firewall, WAF, secret rotation) for prevent.
  4. Remove or disable what is not needed.
  5. Test legitimate access and that the abuse path is blocked.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to servers, prevent, site if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for servers, prevent, site matches “Your servers prevent my site from being hacked”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside servers prevent site
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get servers, prevent, site right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if servers, prevent, site touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
